standard_prerequisites.name: Free abelian presheaves represented by objects of the category, and the adjunction Hom(Z_X, F) = F(X)
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Modules on Sites, Stacks tag 03A8 (sites-modules-lemma-obvious-adjointness), used by the printed context lemma for the identification recorded at its proof line 1021
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the meaning of the terms Z_{U_{i0} times_U ... times_U U_{ip}} out of which the chain complex of the statement is built; the exactness argument itself only uses free abelian groups on sets.

standard_prerequisites.name: Abelian presheaves on a category, morphism sets and fibre products in an arbitrary category
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: the standing conventions of the chapter, restated inside the statement at source lines 1026-1029
standard_prerequisites.use: The statement only assumes that the fibre products U_{i0} times_U ... times_U U_{ip} exist in the category C; the proof works with the sets Mor_C(V, U_{i0} times_U ... times_U U_{ip}) and never needs a site structure.

core_obligations: Reduce exactness of the complex of presheaves to exactness of one complex of abelian groups: evaluate at an object V of C and display Z_{U,bullet}(V) as the complex of free abelian groups on the morphism sets Mor_C(V, U_{i0} times_U ... times_U U_{ip}) (proof lines 1037-1059).

Split that complex by the morphism being tested: introduce Mor_phi(V, U_i) for a morphism phi : V to U, observe that the differentials respect these sets, rewrite the complex as a direct sum over phi, use that Mor_phi(V, U_{i0} times_U ... times_U U_{ip}) is the product of the Mor_phi(V, U_{ij}) and that Z[A] direct sum Z[B] equals Z[A coproduct B], and collapse the summand belonging to phi to the complex of free abelian groups on the single set S_phi = coproduct_i Mor_phi(V, U_i) (proof lines 1060-1132).

Finish the reduced statement: show that for a nonempty set S the extended complex ... to Z[S times S times S] to Z[S times S] to Z[S] to Z to 0 is exact in all degrees by exhibiting the contracting homotopy that sends the basis element n_{(s_0, ..., s_p)} to n_{(s, s_0, ..., s_p)} for a fixed s in S (proof lines 1133-1146).
proof_roadmap: Evaluate at an object V of C and write down the complex Z_{U,bullet}(V) whose terms are free abelian groups on the sets Mor_C(V, U_{i0} times_U ... times_U U_{ip}) (proof lines 1037-1059).

Index the terms by the morphism phi : V to U and its lifts: Mor_phi(V, U_i) = {phi_i : V to U_i with f_i phi_i = phi}, a notation stable under the projections between fibre products (proof lines 1060-1066).

Rewrite the complex as a direct sum over phi of complexes of free abelian groups on products of the sets Mor_phi(V, U_i), using the product formula for morphisms into a fibre product and the identity Z[A] direct sum Z[B] = Z[A coproduct B] (proof lines 1067-1123).
Collapse with S_phi = coproduct_i Mor_phi(V, U_i) to a direct sum over phi of the extended complex of Z[S_phi times S_phi times S_phi] and so on (proof lines 1124-1132).
Prove the reduced statement for an arbitrary nonempty set S by the explicit contracting homotopy n_{(s_0, ..., s_p)} to n_{(s, s_0, ..., s_p)} with s in S fixed (proof lines 1133-1146).
difficulty_reason: The statement is a vanishing result for presheaves on an arbitrary category: for a family of morphisms U_i to U whose fibre products exist, the chain complex Z_{U,bullet} of abelian presheaves built in the printed context lemma has zero homology presheaves in positive degrees (statement lines 1026-1033). What has to be produced is not a citation but a chain of rewritings ending in an explicit homotopy: the proof evaluates at an object V, rewrites the terms as free abelian groups on the morphism sets Mor_C(V, U_{i0} times_U ... times_U U_{ip}), indexes everything by the morphism phi : V to U that is being lifted, uses the identification of morphisms into a fibre product with products of morphisms and the identity Z[A] direct sum Z[B] = Z[A coproduct B] to collapse each phi-summand to a complex on one set S_phi, and then finishes the reduced statement by the contracting homotopy n_{(s_0, ..., s_p)} to n_{(s, s_0, ..., s_p)} (proof lines 1037-1146). Neither the collapsing of the multi-indexed sum nor the homotopy is a formal consequence of the definitions; the case of an empty index set or of a set S with one element has to be seen to fit the same argument.
